items.title: Jake Hanna interviewed by Monk Rowe, Aspen, Colorado, October 11, 1997
items.q: You know this guy Elvis Costello? ... It’s got Chet Baker with Elvis Costello.

ctx.x: Right. What’s your opinion of contemporary jazz these days?

I don’t know. I was — Not bad, but you know, for a second there, but Coleman Hawkins made a very interesting statement one time. Rock & roll. “What do you think of rock & roll?” He says, “There’s nothing wrong with that music it just doesn’t have the right people playing it. It’s just straight eights.” And sure enough he was right. You know this guy Elvis Costello? Well I’m watching a show one night and it’s from Ronnie Scott’s. It’s got Chet Baker with Elvis Costello. I says, “What’s this going to sound like?”…
